title: Physics in Rust: Rapier crates, debris, an explosion and a wrecking ball, drawn per body
note: Rapier bodies built in on_reset, pushed by impulses and joints in on_update, drawn per body under frame.id; one probe per mechanic.
intent: Bodies that fall, are knocked down and blow up are Rapier bodies in sim.physics, never a hand-made solver. Build the level in on_reset (every seed starts empty): RigidBodyBuilder::fixed() ground, RigidBodyBuilder::dynamic() crates with ColliderBuilder::cuboid(..).mass(..), a RigidBodyBuilder::kinematic_position_based() crane moved by body.set_next_kinematic_translation, a ball on RopeJointBuilder::new(len) via physics.insert_impulse_joint. The runtime steps once per tick after on_update: never step it. A blast: physics.intersect_shape with QueryFilter::only_dynamic(), then body.apply_impulse with falloff; a bomb goes off on physics.contact_pair(..).has_any_active_contact() or speed. A shot: physics.cast_ray, body.apply_impulse_at_point, .ccd_enabled(true) only on what flies. Draw each body in on_draw under frame.id(body_id(handle)). Probe each mechanic: "pile" (toppled crates), "blast" (bombs left, blasts, pushed), "wrecking-ball" (on its rope, swung low), "shots"; awake bodies are probe_volatile. Saves: a section of each body's bits (docs/api/physics.md).
port: One facet owns the level's bodies, their update and their probes; a facet that adds a mechanic keeps its own handles in World and moves only its own bodies.

evidence.note: sim.physics is Rapier 0.36 stepped once per tick after on_update; bodies, colliders, impulses, queries, joints, drawing under frame.id, budgets, the save section of body bits and what a load does not restore.
Name everything that moves on its own with frame.id(key) so TAA matches it to its last frame.
Physics: Rapier bodies in sim.physics, drawn under their own frame.id, saved in a section, one probe per mechanic.
